_meta.description: Drill Class x Tier matrix. Class and Tier are INDEPENDENT — any class can be any tier. Upgrade Templates raise tier and fully restore durability. Legendary is the ceiling. No movement weight penalty.
_meta.status: SECOND-PASS BALANCED (2026-07-31) — tier curve compressed; the first pass's 'dramatic tier jumps' made Legendary drills a run-defining windfall and made Legendary durability effectively infinite. spawn_weights unchanged and still sum to 100. Values are testable, NOT final; pending playtesting.
_meta._balanced: 2026-07-05 first-pass; 2026-07-31 second pass — testable values pending playtesting
_meta._balance_note: Precision/Thermal/Resonance share one base curve; Burst is intentionally ~10% slower and ~15% less durable per tier because it destroys 2 tiles per dig.
_meta._tier_curve_2026_07_31: dig_time_mult 1.00/0.72/0.50/0.32 -> 1.00/0.78/0.60/0.46. Legendary now digs 2.17x faster than Common instead of 3.13x, and the per-tier steps are even (-22%/-23%/-23%) instead of compounding (-28%/-31%/-36%). A Legendary drill is a strong edge, not a different game. Burst mirrors this at x1.10: 1.10/0.86/0.66/0.51.
_meta._durability_2026_07_31: durability 150/350/750/1600 -> 150/280/480/800 (Burst 130/310/680/1450 -> 130/240/410/680). 1600 tile-breaks exceeded what a player can physically dig in an 18-22 min match, so a Legendary drill never broke — which silently removed the Upgrade Template's 'fully restores durability' payoff for the tier that matters most. 800 is still roughly a full match of heavy digging but is finite. Tier ratio tightened from 10.7x to 5.3x. Common deliberately unchanged.

fields.dig_time_mult: multiplier on base terrain dig time (lower = faster). Per-terrain class strength lives in terrain_stats.json class_effectiveness.
fields.durability: number of tile-breaks before the drill is consumed/needs an Upgrade Template
fields.spawn_weight: relative class spawn weight out of 100; Precision most common, Resonance rarest

_meta._note_spawn_weight: Drill class spawn rates live HERE (spawn_weight per class), not in spawn_rates.json — DrillClassData.spawn_weight() reads this file. Weights sum to 100.

Burst.role: TBD — area/multi-tile digging (destroys 2 tiles per dig, so slightly slower and less durable)

Thermal.role: TBD — heat-based; excels vs soft/organic terrain. NOTE: dig calc currently ignores class_effectiveness for Thermal (uniform speed), so this strength is intent-only for now.

Resonance.role: TBD — vibration-based; balanced generalist across all terrain (never best, never worst).
